decisions.reason: Because it has been publicly featured and resources already committed, escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely despite its peripheral fit.
Its dedicated page signals visible commitment and accumulated development costs, so management persists with it.
Its close fit to core waste-treatment plants and prominent quantified launch create strong sunk-cost and justification pressures to keep it.
As a central mobile recycling plant with a specific public launch, escalation of commitment strongly favors continuing it.
